chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Abd al-Hamid, who said:

I doubted regarding the matter of Hajiz, so I gathered a few things, then I went to al-ʿAskar. Then there came out to me: “There is no doubt concerning us, nor concerning the one who stands in our place by our command. Return what is with you to Hajiz ibn Yazid.”

key_terms.أَمْرِ: the matter or affair under consideration
key_terms.الْعَسْكَرِ: al-ʿAskar, the place associated here with the Imam عليه السلام
key_terms.مَقَامَنَا: our place or position of authority
key_terms.يَقُومُ: stands or acts in fulfillment of a role

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith affirm the authority of the Imam’s appointed representative?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms confidence in the authority of the Imam عليه السلام and in the representative appointed by his command. It addresses doubt regarding Hajiz ibn Yazid and instructs that the entrusted items be returned to him, underscoring the principle of divinely sanctioned religious authority.
